goal.text: Keep a running, room-by-room record of the tidy-up so the user can confirm at the end that nothing has been left out of place.

turns.text: What have I picked up off the floor so far?

trigger.detail: a pillow has just been set down on the chair

expected_answer.text: So far only pillows. You lifted one off the floor onto the chair, then bent down and gathered a few more.

turns.text: Both hands, or just the one?

trigger.detail: answer still running, user wants detail

expected_answer.text: Both. The second pick-up used both arms; the first was your right hand on its own.

turns.text: actually — what am I carrying to the wall?

trigger.detail: centerpiece lifted off the coffee table

expected_answer.text: A centerpiece display you lifted off the low table with both hands, and you are setting it on the wall shelf.

turns.text: And before that?

trigger.detail: centerpiece placed, wearer turns back

expected_answer.text: Before that you were stacking pillows on the chair and you moved a box off it with your right hand.

turns.text: hold on — is that frame going up there too?

trigger.detail: picture frame lifted from the coffee table

expected_answer.text: Yes. You carried it straight from the low table across to the same shelf and set it down with both hands.

turns.text: Mm. So that's two things up there now?

trigger.detail: picture frame placed on the wall shelf

expected_answer.text: Two so far. The centerpiece went up first, then the frame. Nothing else has reached that shelf yet.

turns.text: Okay, scratch that count. What just joined them up there?

trigger.detail: books placed on the wall shelf

expected_answer.text: Books. You carried an armful over from the low table and slid them onto the shelf with both hands.

turns.text: Where did those come from before they were in my hands?

trigger.detail: user probes provenance mid-answer

expected_answer.text: They came out of a box. You set that box down on the low table a moment earlier, then lifted the books out.

turns.text: oh — by the way, how many pillows on that chair?

trigger.detail: wearer walks away towards the sofa

expected_answer.text: Three. One went up on its own, then a pair you carried together, and none came back down afterwards.

turns.text: Right hand first again?

trigger.detail: soft toys lifted off the sofa

expected_answer.text: Right hand again. You scooped a soft toy up off the sofa and passed it across into your left.

turns.text: Mm-hm. Mm — actually, how many am I holding now?

trigger.detail: backchannel grows into a question

expected_answer.text: Two at that point, both in the left hand, and your right is reaching for a third one off the cushion.

turns.text: hang on — don't those belong in the box?

trigger.detail: toys being set down on the corner table

expected_answer.text: No, you emptied that box onto the shelf already. These are going straight down on the corner table instead.

turns.text: So what pulled my eyes away just then?

trigger.detail: gaze left the toys for the doorway across the room

expected_answer.text: The doorway across the room. You looked up at it while you were still bent over the table with a toy in hand.

turns.text: Right. Next thing in my hands after those?

trigger.detail: wearer straightens up and turns

expected_answer.text: A bean bag. You picked it up with your right hand, turned round, and dropped it onto the floor by the sofa.

turns.text: Okay, back to the running list. What's happening out here now?

trigger.detail: vacuum pushed into the hall closet

expected_answer.text: You are pushing a vacuum into the hall cupboard with both hands, after dragging it over from where it stood in the way.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — did I step round it earlier?

trigger.detail: user recalls the approach down the hall

expected_answer.text: Yes. Coming into the hallway you sidestepped to the left to get past it before you opened the cupboard door.

turns.text: So is it shut properly?

trigger.detail: closet door pushed to and the lock turned

expected_answer.text: Shut and locked. You pushed the door to with each hand in turn, then twisted the latch left and then right.

turns.text: What about that off the floor?

trigger.detail: towel picked up from the hall floor

expected_answer.text: A towel. You crouched and grabbed it with your right hand while walking, then held it in both hands.

turns.text: oh, before I forget, where did the soft toys end up?

trigger.detail: user reopens the living room thread

expected_answer.text: All three on the corner table in the living room. You put two down with your right hand and the last one after that.

turns.text: Right. And where's that one going?

trigger.detail: towels being arranged on the closet shelf

expected_answer.text: Onto a shelf inside the hall cupboard. You laid it down right handed and then pushed it back to straighten the pile.

turns.text: So how many loads has that taken?

trigger.detail: user wants a count mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Two trips. One armful off the hall floor, then a second pile you bent down for straight afterwards.

turns.text: New room. What am I hanging up in here?

trigger.detail: gaze left the doorway for the wall beside the closet

expected_answer.text: Shirts on hangers. You lifted them off the bed with your right hand, swapped the hooks over, and hooked them on the rail.

turns.text: um, hang on — which hand did the hooks?

trigger.detail: user narrows their own question

expected_answer.text: Your left took the hooks first and handed them across, and your right did the actual hanging on the rail.

turns.text: And off the floor just now?

trigger.detail: folded towel lifted from the bedroom floor

expected_answer.text: A folded towel. You picked it up right handed, folded it again with both, and put it on a shelf in there.

turns.text: So that's this floor clear?

trigger.detail: user checks progress

expected_answer.text: Not quite. There is still a second batch waiting on the bed, and some pillows down by your feet.

turns.text: Getting them now?

trigger.detail: second armful of hangers lifted off the bed

expected_answer.text: Yes, the second lot of hangers. Same routine: off the bed right handed, hooks swapped over, then onto the rail.

turns.text: no no — I meant, has anything gone in there that shouldn't have?

trigger.detail: user repairs their previous question

expected_answer.text: Nothing out of place. Only clothes on the rail and towels on the shelves, which is what was in there already.

turns.text: Alright. Bed next?

trigger.detail: gaze left the plain wall for the picture above the bed

expected_answer.text: Already underway. You tucked the cover under the mattress right handed, smoothed the side, and now pillows are going up.

turns.text: How many of those have gone up?

trigger.detail: pillows piled and flipped at the bedhead

expected_answer.text: Two so far at the head end. You carried one in each hand off the floor, then stacked and flipped them over.

turns.text: speaking of which, did the living room ones ever come back down?

trigger.detail: user reaches back past the current room

expected_answer.text: No. All three stayed where you put them, and nothing has been taken off that seat since you walked out of there.

turns.text: Still on the beds? What's left there?

trigger.detail: gaze moved from one framed print to another

expected_answer.text: Pillows again. You lifted a pair off the floor onto the mattress and are now shuffling them into a tidy row.

turns.text: So which room has taken the longest?

trigger.detail: user wants a whole-session comparison

expected_answer.text: This one by a distance. You have been in here since roughly three minutes in, against about a minute and a half out in the hall.

turns.text: mm — sorry, what did I do with the shirts again?

trigger.detail: user reopens the clothes thread

expected_answer.text: They went on the rail in the wardrobe here, in two batches, both lifted off the mattress before the bedding was done.

turns.text: And before those?

trigger.detail: pillow row finished on the near bed

expected_answer.text: Before them you were still in the hall, pushing towels onto a shelf and shutting the cupboard behind you.

turns.text: Did I look away from the bed there?

trigger.detail: gaze left the print for the blank wall by the closet

expected_answer.text: Yes, over to the blank stretch of wall by the wardrobe, just as you scooped the towels up and turned for the sliding door.

turns.text: Is it open yet?

trigger.detail: sliding closet door being pushed across

expected_answer.text: You have it part way across with your right hand, left arm still clamped around the load.

turns.text: Another room. Talk me through it.

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall for the bathroom doorway

expected_answer.text: You are in the bathroom now, checking the towels on the rail, then closing a drawer under the counter.

turns.text: hey, sorry — anything still on the floor down there?

trigger.detail: user asks about the floor out of frame

expected_answer.text: There was a pile beside the cabinet. You held the door with your left, picked them up right handed, and lifted them onto the counter.

turns.text: So that's the third lot of towels today?

trigger.detail: user tries to total the session

expected_answer.text: Fourth, counting properly: two piles in the hall, one folded one in the bedroom, and now this lot in here.

turns.text: Where did those end up in the end?

trigger.detail: gaze left the doorway for the wall above the basin

expected_answer.text: On the basin first, so you could check them, and then the big one went back onto the rail with both hands.

turns.text: And the smaller one?

trigger.detail: hand towel dropped by the taps

expected_answer.text: That smaller one got dropped by the taps with your right hand and left there while you dealt with the other.

turns.text: that's not — sorry, I meant the one from the bedroom.

trigger.detail: user repairs the reference

expected_answer.text: That never left the bedroom. You folded it on the spot and slid it onto a shelf inside the wardrobe there.

turns.text: Last room. What am I shifting about in here?

trigger.detail: gaze left the wall for the window across the room

expected_answer.text: Chairs. You are walking the length of the table and lifting one with both hands to carry it round.

turns.text: So am I nearly done?

trigger.detail: user checks whether the sweep is finished

expected_answer.text: Nearly. Chairs pushed back under and the sweep of the house is finished.

turns.text: Then give me the whole run, room by room.

trigger.detail: user asks for the closing summary

expected_answer.text: Living room cushions and ornaments, hall cupboard with the vacuum and towels, bedroom clothes and beds, bathroom towels, chairs in here.

turns.text: uh, wait — did I miss anything?

trigger.detail: user asks for anything left undone

expected_answer.text: One thing. A bean bag is still sitting on the living room floor where you dropped it rather than put away.
